ipxact:register.ipxact:name: cmd
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: FW uses this register to execute various FW commands in Secure Instruction Cache, one at a time. FW must program this register as one-hot encoded. When set, FW must clear test_en first and then set another bit as required. After initiating the command, Status register can be read to know the status of the FW command.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: set_init_state
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: It initiates SInC command to transition from Disabled to Initialization state. HW clears this bit after transition completes or SInC encounters an error. Only allowed in Disabled state.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: set_cache_active_state
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: It initiates SInC command to transition from Initialization to Cache-active state. HW clears this bit after transition completes or SInC encounters an error. Only allowed in Initialization state.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: sinc_reset
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: If sinc_reset_disabled is set to 0 in status register, setting this bit will cause SInC to erase the cache IRAM, erase VTAG, clear the locally stored key, reset the MPU permissions and move to Disabled state. HW clears this bit after transition completes or SInC encounters an error. If sinc_reset_disabled is set, writing this bit will result in invalid command error. Only allowed in Initialization, Cache-Active and Cache-Failed state

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: sinc_reinit
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: If sinc_reinit_disabled is set to 0 in status register, setting this bit will cause SInC to erase the cache IRAM, erase VTAG and move to Initialization state. The locally stored key and the MPU permissions are preserved. HW clears this bit after transition completes or SInC encounters an error. If sinc_reinit_disabled is set, writing this bit will result in invalid command error. Only allowed in Cache-Active state

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: encr_block
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Initiates block encryption operation by reading the blocks from Sharedram, encrypting it and writing it along with authentication tags to external memory. It uses block_encr_num, num_of_blocks and block_encr_addr registers to execute this command. HW clears this bit after all blocks and authentication tags are written to external memory. Only allowed in Initialization state.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: disable_reset
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: It sets the sinc_reset_disabled status to 1 and doesn't allow SInC reset command until next reset. HW clears this bit after one clock cycle. Only allowed in Disabled, Initialization and Cache-Active state.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: disable_reinit
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: It sets the sinc_reinit_disabled status to 1 and doesn't allow SInC Re-Initialization command until next reset. HW clears this bit after one clock cycle. Only allowed in Disabled, Initialization and Cache-Active state.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: aes_test_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Set this bit to enable AES test mode. FW must clear this bit to exit out of AES test mode unless an error is encountered. HW clears this bit if an error is encountered while initiating or executing AES test mode. This bit must be cleared before setting any other bit in cmd register. Only allowed in Disabled state.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: block_encr_num
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Block number of the first block to be encrypted in encrypt block command. Block number increments by 1 for every subsequent cache blocks to be encrypted. Writes to this register are discared if SInC is not in Disabled or Initialization state.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: block_encr_num
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Block number

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: num_of_blocks
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Number of blocks to be encrypted in encrypt block command. Writes to this register are discared if SInC is not in Disabled or Initialization state.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: num_of_blocks
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of blocks to be encrypted

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: block_encr_addr
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: AXI address targetting Sharedram from where the cache block will be fetched in an encrypt block command. Subsequent cache blocks are read from next contiguous location. Writes to this register are discared if SInC is not in Disabled or Initialization state.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: block_encr_addr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: AXI address targetting Sharedram

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: block_encr_key
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: KSU key slot number from where SInC will fetch the block encryption key for encryption and decryption. Writes to this register are discared if SInC is not in Disabled state.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: block_encr_key
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: KSU key slot number

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: aes_iv_nonce_0
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Contains bits[31:0] of AES-GCM 96-bit IV Nonce value. Writes to this register are discared if SInC is not in Disabled state.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: aes_iv_nonce_0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Bits[31:0] of AES-GCM 96-bit IV Nonce value.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: aes_iv_nonce_1
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Contains bits[63:32] of AES-GCM 96-bit IV Nonce value. Writes to this register are discared if SInC is not in Disabled state.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: aes_iv_nonce_1
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Bits[63:32] of AES-GCM 96-bit IV Nonce value.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: aes_iv_nonce_2
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Contains bits [95:64] of AES-GCM 96-bit IV Nonce value. Only Bits [7:0] of this register are used during AES in functional mode i.e., encryption or decryption. Bits [31:0] of this register are used during AES in test mode. Writes to this register are discared if SInC is not in Disabled state.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: aes_iv_nonce_2
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Bits[71:64] of AES-GCM 96-bit IV Nonce value.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: aes_iv_nonce_2_test
ipxact:field.ipxact:displayName: AES GCM IV Nonce 2 test mode
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Bits[95:72] of AES-GCM 96-bit IV Nonce value, used only in AES test mode.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ext_block_base_addr
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Base address targetting DMB, to route transactions to/from external memory. This base address itself points to block 0 in external memory. The lower bits of this register must be set to 0 as the block base address must be aligned to block boundary. The number of bits tied low depends on the cache block size. Writes to this register are discared if SInC is not in Disabled or Initialization state.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ext_block_base_addr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Base address targetting DMB to access data in external memory. This base address corresponds to cache block 0 and corresponding blocks are stored contiguously.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ext_auth_tag_base_addr
ipxact:register.ipxact:displayName: External authentication tag base address register
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Base address targetting DMB, to route transactions to/from external memory. This base address itself points to authentication tag for block 0 in external memory. The lower 4 bits of this register must be set to 0 as the authentication tag base address must be aligned to tag size (16B). Writes to this register are discared if SInC is not in Disabled or Initialization state.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ext_auth_tag_base_addr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Base address targetting DMB to access authentication tag in external memory. This base address corresponds to authentication tag for cache block 0 and corresponding authentication tags are stored contiguously.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: status
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Secure Instruction Cache Status register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: state
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 0x00 - Disabled 0x0F - Initialization 0xF0 - Cache-active 0xFF - Cache-failed

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: sinc_reset_disabled
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 0 - SInC reinit command is allowed 1 - SInC reinit command is not allowed

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: sinc_reinit_disabled
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 0 - SInC reinit command is allowed 1 - SInC reinit command is not allowed

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: cmd_in_progress
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: SInC is processing a FW command or a fetch block request from CIU due to cache miss.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: cmd_success
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: SInC completed FW command successfully. NOTE: This bit is not set when fetch block request is completed.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: cmd_failed
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: FW command or fetch block request failed. See other bits to know the reason of command failure.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: invalid_cmd_err
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Invalid command error. Incorrect programming of cmd register OR Command requested is not supported in current sinc state OR Command is disabled OR AES test mode configuration is set incorrectly.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rng_seed_r_err
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: SInC failed to read the seed from RNG to seed AES.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: key_fetch_err
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: SInC failed to fetch the key from KSU.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: cache_block_r_err
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: SInC failed to read the cache block during encrypt block or fetch block command. In encrypt block comamnd, SInC reads cache block from Sharedram. In fetch block command, SInC reads cache block from external memory.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: cache_block_w_err_encr_block
ipxact:field.ipxact:displayName: Write cache block error during encrypt block command
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: SInC failed to write the cache block to external memory during encrypt block command.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: cache_block_w_err_fetch_block
ipxact:field.ipxact:displayName: Write cache block error during fetch block command
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: SInC failed to write the cache block to CIRAM during fetch block command due to ongoing memory erase.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: auth_tag_r_err
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: SInC failed to read the authentication tag from external memory during fetch block command.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: auth_tag_chk_err
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Generated authentication tag didn't match the expected authentication tag (fetched from external memory) during fetch block command.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: auth_tag_w_err
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: SInC failed to write the authentication tag to external memory during encrypt block command.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: aes_err
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: AES in SInC encountered command fault error .

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: sinc_hw_fault
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: HW fault error encountered in SInC. Possible reasons are FSM transitioning into na invalid state OR uncorrectable error encountered during CIRAM read.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: hit_cntr_lower
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Lower 32b of the hit counter value. The hit counter is the number of cache-hit events. Hit counter is enabled only when hit_cntr_en bit is set in Performance counters control register. Counter is reset when hit_cntr_clr bit is set. It stops counting if it reaches the max value.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: hit_cntr_lower
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Lower 32b of the hit counter value

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: hit_cntr_upper
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Upper 16b of the hit counter value. The hit counter is the number of cache-hit events. Hit counter is enabled only when hit_cntr_en is set to 1 in Performance counters control register. Counter is reset when hit_cntr_clr bit is set. It stops counting if it reaches the max value.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: hit_cntr_upper
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Upper 16b of the hit counter value

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: miss_cntr_lower
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Lower 32b of the miss counter value. The miss counter is the number of cache-miss events. Miss counter is enabled only when miss_cntr_en is set to 1 in Performance counters control register. Counter is reset when miss_cntr_clr bit is set. It stops counting if it reaches the max value.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: miss_cntr_lower
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Lower 32b of the miss counter value

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: miss_cntr_upper
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Upper 16b of the miss counter value. The miss counter is the number of cache-miss events. Miss counter is enabled only when miss_cntr_en is set to 1 in Performance counters control register. Counter is reset when miss_cntr_clr bit is set. It stops counting if it reaches the max value.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: miss_cntr_upper
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Upper 16b of the miss counter value

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: lat_cntr_lower
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Lower 32b of the latency counter value. The latency counter counts the number of clock cycles from when SInC initiated the DMA read to fetch block data to when last byte of block data is received. Note that the counter accumulates the count value for every cache-miss. Latency counter is enabled only when lat_cntr_en is set in Performance counters control register. Counter is reset when lat_cntr_clr is set. It stops counting if it reaches the max value.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: lat_cntr_lower
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Lower 32b of the latency counter value

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: lat_cntr_upper
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Upper 32b of the latency counter value. The latency counter counts the number of clock cycles from when SInC initiated the DMA read to fetch block data to when last byte of block data is received. Note that the counter accumulates the count value for every cache-miss. Latency counter is enabled only when lat_cntr_en is set in Performance counters control register. Counter is reset when lat_cntr_clr is set. It stops counting if it reaches the max value.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: lat_cntr_upper
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Upper 16b of the latency counter value

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: perf_cntr_ctrl
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: This register controls operation of the performance counter in SInC.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: hit_cntr_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Set to enable the hit counter.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: hit_cntr_clr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Set to reset/clear the hit counter.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: miss_cntr_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Set to enable the miss counter.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: miss_cntr_clr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Set to reset/clear the miss counter.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: lat_cntr_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Set to enable the latency counter.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: lat_cntr_clr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Set to reset/clear the latency counter.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: aes_test_data_in_0
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Bits 31:0 of AES input block in test mode. Load this register before setting data_in_vld in AES test control register.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: aes_test_data_in_0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Bits 31:0 of AES input block in test mode

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: aes_test_data_in_1
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Bits 63:32 of AES input block in test mode. Load this register before setting data_in_vld in AES test control register.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: aes_test_data_in_1
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Bits 63:32 of AES input block in test mode

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: aes_test_data_in_2
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Bits 95:64 of AES input block in test mode. Load this register before setting data_in_vld in AES test control register.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: aes_test_data_in_2
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Bits 95:64 of AES input block in test mode

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: aes_test_data_in_3
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Bits 127:96 of AES input block in test mode. Load this register before setting data_in_vld in AES test control register.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: aes_test_data_in_3
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Bits 127:96 of AES input block in test mode

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: aes_test_data_out_0
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Bits 31:0 of AES output block in test mode. This register contains valid data when data_out_vld is set in AES test status register. HW clears this register when data_out_ack is set.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: aes_test_data_out_0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Bits 31:0 of AES output block in test mode

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: aes_test_data_out_1
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Bits 63:32 of AES output block in test mode. This register contains valid data when data_out_vld is set in AES test status register. HW clears this register when data_out_ack is set.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: aes_test_data_out_1
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Bits 63:32 of AES output block in test mode

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: aes_test_data_out_2
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Bits 95:64 of AES output block in test mode. This register contains valid data when data_out_vld is set in AES test status register. HW clears this register when data_out_ack is set.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: aes_test_data_out_2
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Bits 95:64 of AES output block in test mode

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: aes_test_data_out_3
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Bits 127:96 of AES output block in test mode. This register contains valid data when data_out_vld is set in AES test status register. HW clears this register when data_out_ack is set.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: aes_test_data_out_3
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Bits 127:96 of AES output block in test mode

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: aes_test_ctrl
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: This register enables AES in test mode and controls its input/output parameters.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: mode
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Sets AES mode when cfg_key_iv_vld is set. 4'h1 - ECB 4'h7 - GCM Write to this field is ignored if cfg_key_iv_rdy is not set.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: dir
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Sets AES direction when cfg_key_iv_vld is set. 1 - Ecnrypt 0 - Decrypt Write to this field is ignored if cfg_key_iv_rdy is not set.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: key_len
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Sets AES key length when cfg_key_iv_vld is set. 2'h0 - Reserved 2'h1 - Reserved 2'h2 - 256b key 2'h3 - Reserved Write to this field is ignored if cfg_key_iv_rdy is not set.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: reuse_key
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set along with cfg_key_iv_vld bit, SInC won't read a new key from KSU and keep using previously loaded key. Write to this field is ignored if cfg_key_iv_rdy is not set.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: cfg_key_iv_vld
ipxact:field.ipxact:displayName: AES config, key and IV valid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Wait for cfg_key_iv_rdy = 1. Once cfg_key_iv_rdy is set, setting this bit will do following things. 1. SInC loads mode and dir in AES. 2. SInC reads the key from KSU key slot # based on value in block encryption key register, stores it locally and loads it in AES. If reuse_key is set, SInC skips reading the key from KSU and reuses locally stored key (that was fetched earlier). 3. SInC loads IV from IV nonce* registes in AES. HW clears this bit after one clock cycle of cfg_key_iv_vld and cfg_key_iv_rdy handshake. Write to this field is ignored if cfg_key_iv_rdy is not set.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: data_in_vld
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Wait for data_in_rdy = 1. Once data_in_rdy is set, setting this field causes SInC to load data from AES test data in 0..3 as AES input block. HW clears this bit after one clock cycle of data_in_vld and data_in_rdy handshake. Write to this field is ignored if data_in_rdy is not set.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: data_in_byte_cnt
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set along with data_in_vld and data_in_last is set, this field indicates how many bytes are valid in AES test data in 0..3. Write to this field is ignored if data_in_rdy is not set.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: data_in_last
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set along with data_in_vld, it indicates the input data block is the last input block. Write to this field is ignored if data_in_rdy is not set.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: data_in_aad_sel
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set along with data_in_vld, it indicates whether the input data block is PT/CT or AAD. This version does not support AAD. 1 - Reserved 0 - PT/CT Write to this field is ignored if data_in_rdy is not set.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: data_out_ack
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Wait for data_out_vld = 1. Once data_out_vld is set, setting this bit indicates that the AES test data out 0..3 registers have been read by FW. HW clears this field after one clock cycle data_out_vld and data_out_ack handshake. Write to this field is ignored if data_out_vld is not set.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: aes_test_status
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: This register contains the status of AES and its parameters while AES is in test mode.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: cfg_key_iv_rdy
ipxact:field.ipxact:displayName: AES config, key and IV ready
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that AES is ready to receive AES config, key and IV in AES test mode. If this field is set, cfg_key_iv_vld field can be set to load new configuration, key and IV into AES.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: data_in_rdy
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that AES is ready to receive input data block in AES test mode. If this field is set, data_in_vld can be set to load new input block.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: data_out_vld
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that AES test data out 0..3 registers contain valid data. If this field is set, data_out_ack field can be set after reading the data out 0..3 registers to acknowledge that output test data has been read.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: tag_out
ipxact:field.ipxact:displayName: Mux select for AES test data out 0..3 registers
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates whether the AES test data out 0..3 registers contain output data block or authentication tag. 0 - Output data block 1 - Authentication tag

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: encr_block_status
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Shows status of encrypt block command

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: num_of_blocks_encr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Shows number of blocks successfully encrypted before encrypt block command failed. May be used for debug purposes. This field remains unchanged if encrypt command successfully completes.
